11.t: Working with data: helmets and injuries
q: How many serious head injuries per 1000 crashes were there before the law?
By how much did the number fall in the first year?
Calculate the percentage fall from before the law to 5 years after.
A student says "the law alone caused the whole fall". Evaluate this claim.

The fall is large and starts straight after the law, which supports a link: helmets slow the head’s stop and spread the force. But other changes may also help: better roads, speed limits, safer bikes, faster ambulances; and not everyone wears a helmet correctly. So the law is likely a big cause but not the only one.
